title: Adaptive AI Task Partitioning and Safe Offloading in Heterogeneous Edge-Cloud Continuum
abstract: arXiv:2605.09623v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In recent years, the use of artificial intelligence on resource-constrained IoT devices has grown significantly. However, existing approaches to AI task partitioning and offloading across the edge-cloud continuum typically rely on static methods that ignore runtime dynamics. Furthermore, they are often evaluated in simulated environments rather than on real hardware. To address this gap, we propose a framework that dynamically splits neural network layers across the heterogeneous continuum. The framework profiles the model at startup, measures network link conditions between nodes, and periodically re-evaluates the partition to adapt to environmental changes. We created a physical testbed comprising a Raspberry Pi edge device, a laptop fog, and a high-performance desktop PC as the cloud. translated_title: 异构边缘-云连续体中的自适应AI任务划分与安全卸载
translated_abstract: 近年来，在资源受限的物联网设备上使用人工智能的需求显著增长。然而，现有的跨边缘-云连续体进行AI任务划分和卸载的方法通常依赖静态方法，忽略了运行时动态变化。此外，这些方法往往在模拟环境中评估，而非在真实硬件上测试。为弥补这一差距，我们提出了一种框架，该框架能动态地将神经网络层拆分到异构连续体中。该框架在启动时对模型进行性能剖析，测量节点间的网络链路条件，并定期重新评估划分方案以适应环境变化。我们构建了一个物理测试平台，包括作为边缘设备的树莓派、作为雾节点的笔记本电脑，以及作为云的高性能台式电脑。我们使用三种广泛采用的卷积神经网络（VGG16、AlexNet和MobileNetV2）对该框架进行了评估。结果表明，该框架...
tldr: 提出一种在真实硬件上动态划分神经网络层、适应运行时环境变化的边缘-云协同框架，并在树莓派、笔记本电脑和台式机构建的测试平台上验证了其有效性。
en_tdlr: We propose a framework that dynamically partitions neural network layers across heterogeneous edge-cloud continuum, adapts to runtime changes, and is validated on a real testbed with Raspberry Pi, laptop, and desktop PC.
